text:
devon: Heads-up: proposal to split the analytics 'route_id' into (org_id, short_route) to reduce index cardinality and support faster cross-org joins. We'll introduce `route_key_v2` + `org_id` and keep legacy `route_id` for compatibility. Opening thread for rollout concerns.

carmen: what's the migration surface? massive backfill? dashboard compatibility?

devon: short version: add nullable columns `org_id` (uuid) and `route_key_v2` (text). runtime will dual-write both legacy and v2 for an initial period (~60d). backfill job for cold partitions + streaming backfill for last 30d. avoid rewriting current hot partitions synchronously.

matt: console queries currently use `route_id` everywhere. do we plan reads to continue hitting the old column until cutover? indexes will be impacted.

devon: reads will prefer v2 when present; we'll introduce a view `route_unified` and make console point at it. view uses `COALESCE(route_key_v2, route_id)` so product code doesn't need immediate changes.

sylvia: big concern: our hourly rollups + materialized aggregates group by route_id. changing grouping keys can break counts and produce dupes. how will we ensure determinism?

devon: good call. rollups will be updated to GROUP BY `COALESCE(route_key_v2, route_id)` and we will run a side-by-side run for 24h to compare metrics. We won't swap materialized views until parity is confirmed (within small epsilon).

carmen: backfill throttling? last time a big job pegged the ingest DB and caused console timeouts.

devon: backfill will use our existing backfill runner with `--max-conns=8 --batch-size=5000 --sleep-ms=200` and a dynamic rate limiter based on CPU and replication lag. We'll start on a single partition and ramp.

matt: saved dashboards and alerts embed `route_id` in JSON filters. migration script needed for stored queries. also need migration for all UI filter autocompletes.

devon: agreed. plan: produce a mapping report from dual-write data (old->v2) and run a dry-run transformation that shows how many saved queries change. then run a non-blocking migration that updates dashboard JSONs replacing \"route_id\": \"...\" with \"route_key_v2\": \"...\" and adds a fallback filter clause if mapping missing. We'll ship the console code to understand both keys for 30d.

sylvia: storage overhead: extra columns + indexes will increase table size. do we have an estimate?

devon: ballpark: route_key_v2 avg 24 bytes, org_id 16 bytes; expected table size +6-10%. mitigation: use TOAST/compression for route_key_v2, and create a partial index on `route_key_v2` WHERE route_key_v2 IS NOT NULL to avoid bloating the primary index. also consider pg_hint_plan for heavy queries if needed.

matt: telemetry/observability: we should add metrics for dual-write mismatch rate, cardinality delta, and query latency. create a dashboard and a PagerDuty runbook for abnormal spikes.

devon: yes — adding prometheus exporters for: `analytics.dual_write_mismatch_total`, `analytics.route_key_cardinality`, and `console.query_latency_route_lookup`. We'll also add a data-quality job that samples 1% of incoming rows and checks v2 vs legacy parity.

ingest-bot: deploy scheduled: schema-alter window queued for 2026-04-02T02:00Z (low-traffic). migration runbook link: https://intranet.redwood/infra/route-id-split-runbook (internal).

carmen: owners? devon runtime, sylvia rollups/backfills, matt console/dashboard migration. please tag eng-oncall for the run window.

devon: assigning: @devon runtime + backfill script, @sylvia rollup + db index changes, @matt console migration scaffolding. I'll draft the PR with SQL snippets and the backfill playbook. posting draft in ~2h.

matt: tiny nit — include an example SQL view we'll use so reviewers know exact behavior.

devon: adding example now:

```sql
-- route_unified view: prefer v2 but keep legacy for missing data
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW analytics.route_unified AS
SELECT
  id, -- original pk
  COALESCE(route_key_v2, route_id) as route_key_unified,
  org_id,
  ts,
  payload
FROM analytics.events;
```

devon: thanks all. I'll include the `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ON analytics.events (route_key_v2) WHERE route_key_v2 IS NOT NULL;` in the migration. tagging @eng-oncall and @eng-platform for visibility.
